post.description:
Image generation by ideogram/v3-text-to-image

Output format: WebP.

## Create Task

Use this endpoint to create a new image generation task.

<Card title="Get Task Details" icon="lucide-search" href="/market/common/get-task-detail">
  After submission, use the unified query endpoint to check task progress and retrieve results
</Card>

::: tip[]
For production use, we recommend providing the `callBackUrl` parameter so your service can receive completion notifications instead of polling for task status.
:::

model.description:
The model name used for generation. This field is required.

- This endpoint must use the `ideogram/v3-text-to-image` model

callBackUrl.description: Callback URL for task completion notifications. Optional parameter. If provided, the system will send a POST request to this URL when the task completes, whether it succeeds or fails. If omitted, no callback notification will be sent.

input.description: Input parameters for the generation task.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate. Maximum length: 5000 characters.
examples: A cinematic photograph of a tranquil lakeside at twilight, viewed from a slight elevation. In the center, a cluster of softly glowing reeds and water lilies emit a gentle golden light, their reflections shimmering on the calm surface. The elegant neon-style white text 'Kie.ai' hovers just above the water, subtly illuminated and harmonizing with the natural glow. Surrounding willows and drifting mist frame the scene, creating a serene yet magical atmosphere, with warm highlights contrasting against the cool blues of the evening sky.

rendering_speed.description:
The rendering speed to use.

- `TURBO`: Turbo
- `BALANCED`: Balanced
- `QUALITY`: Quality

style.description:
The style type to generate with.

- `AUTO`: Auto
- `GENERAL`: General
- `REALISTIC`: Realistic
- `DESIGN`: Design

expand_prompt.description:
Determines whether MagicPrompt should be used to enhance the generation request.

- Boolean value: `true` / `false`

image_size.description:
The resolution of the generated image.

- `square`: Square
- `square_hd`: Square HD
- `portrait_4_3`: Portrait 3:4
- `portrait_16_9`: Portrait 9:16
- `landscape_4_3`: Landscape 4:3
- `landscape_16_9`: Landscape 16:9

seed.description: Seed for the random number generator.

negative_prompt.description: Description of what to exclude from the generated image. If the positive prompt conflicts with the negative prompt, the positive prompt takes precedence. Maximum length: 5000 characters.

input.negative_prompt: blurry, low detail, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed text, watermark

taskId.description: Task ID, which can be used to query task status through the task detail endpoint.

post.description: Sent when the task succeeds or fails.

code.description: 200: success. 501: failure; see data.failCode and data.failMsg.

completeTime.description: Task completion time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

costTime.description: Processing time in seconds. Present on both success and failure callbacks.

createTime.description: Task creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

creditsConsumed.description: Credits consumed by the task; 0 for failed tasks.

param.description: Parameters submitted when creating the task, formatted as a JSON string

resultJson.description: Image generation result formatted as a JSON string. `resultUrls` contains the URLs of the generated images. Present only when state is success.

updateTime.description: Use completeTime as the completion time; updateTime may equal createTime.

failCode.description: Failure code, a numeric string such as "400" or "500". Present only when state is fail.

failMsg.description: Failure reason. Present only when state is fail.

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

msg.description: Response message, error description upon failure

taskId.description: The task ID can be used with the "Get Task Details" endpoint to query the task status.

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
